The '''marsh-gunnies''' were small<ref name="CSWE" /> creatures native to [[Nim Drovis]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="pot" /> They occupied the bayous,<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], and marshes of Nim Drovis.<ref name="pot" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' to [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> when the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived on the planet along with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Bortrek]], their landing pad was surrounded by swamps filled with marsh-gunnies, [[gulper]]s and [[Color/Legends|green]]-eyed [[wadie-platt]]s.<ref name="pot" />

==Behind the scenes==
The marsh-gunnies were created by [[Barbara Hambly]] for her novel, ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'', published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[1997]].<ref name="pot" />
